mapper.sql: FROM order_item item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = item.passenger_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train ON train.id = run.train_id JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND to_stop.stop_seq = item.to_seq JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = item.seat_type_id LEFT JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.id = item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id
mapper.select:
SELECT item.id AS ticket_id, item.order_id, orders.order_no, item.status AS ticket_status, item.passenger_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, item.run_id, train.train_no, item.from_station_id, from_station.name AS from_station_name, item.to_station_id, to_station.name AS to_station_name, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AS arrival_date_time, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.price, COALESCE(payment.paid_at, item.updated_at) AS issued_at
LEFT JOIN payment_record payment ON payment.id = ( SELECT MAX(success_payment.id) FROM payment_record success_payment WHERE success_payment.order_id = item.order_id AND success_payment.status = 'SUCCESS' ) WHERE orders.user_id = #{userId} AND item.status IN ('ISSUED', 'REFUNDED', 'CHANGED')
AND item.status = #{status}
ORDER BY departure_date_time DESC, item.id DESC

SELECT item.id AS ticket_id, item.order_id, orders.order_no, orders.status AS order_status, item.status AS ticket_status, item.passenger_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, passenger.id_type, item.run_id, run.run_date, run.run_status, train.train_no, item.from_station_id, from_station.name AS from_station_name, item.from_seq, item.to_station_id, to_station.name AS to_station_name, item.to_seq, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AS arrival_date_time, item.seat_type_id, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, item.seat_id, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.price, payment.paid_at, item.created_at, item.updated_at
LEFT JOIN payment_record payment ON payment.id = ( SELECT MAX(success_payment.id) FROM payment_record success_payment WHERE success_payment.order_id = item.order_id AND success_payment.status = 'SUCCESS' ) WHERE item.id = #{ticketId} AND orders.user_id = #{userId} AND item.status IN ('ISSUED', 'REFUNDED', 'CHANGED') LIMIT 1
